Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
Greetings;

Online Card text:
Magazine [Anarchs:R]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable before range is determined.
Put this card on a gun on this minion and put an ammo card from your hand on this card. When using this gun, you may use the effect
of the ammo card as if it were played from your hand. <Pay cost as normal.>

Question: It appears that you can play a magazine on a gun, fail to put an
ammo card on the magazine (cause you don't have any or don't want to)
and have a useless magazine on the gun for the remainder of the game.

Is that a correct interpretation?

Thanks,
-JTP
Winnipeg

Messages.Author: Kitzune
Messages.Body:
> and put an ammo card from your hand on this card.

You dont meet this requirement for playing Magazine, therefor you can not play it.
